openingSummary.zh: 过去约一日的新主线是「Claude Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2 发布」与「小模型扛日常 Agent 步骤、研究侧安全熔断」：@claudeai 与 @AnthropicAI 宣布 Claude Fable 5.2 与 Mythos 5.2（同一底座；Fable 带更强安全护栏、面向所有付费用户与主流云，Mythos 需经生命科学/网络安全验证项目申请）。官方评测称 FrontierCode 2.0 在 Xhigh 努力档约 49.1%，高于 Opus 5.5（45.5%）、GPT-6 Astra（42.8%）与 Gemini 4 Carbon（41.1%，Medium）；API 定价降至每百万 token $8 输入 / $40 输出（可选 fast mode $16/$80），并建议大多数编码与知识工作仍从 Opus 5.5 起步。@OpenAI 介绍 Control Room：把研究侧含 agentic sampling 的推理负载接入中央熔断，决策后约 35 秒内停掉模型输出。@AIatMeta 发布面向日常 agent 步骤的小模型 Muse Ember（1M 上下文，$0.10/$0.50），称在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 上接近 Claude Haiku 5.5、单价约三分之一，并高于 GPT-6 Luna 各推理档。研究侧 alphaXiv 热榜的 Agent 向论文包括 SwarmEvolve、Video-Coder 与 FlashState。缺口：@karpathy / @AndrewYNg / @GoogleAI / @GoogleDeepMind / @Meta 近 48h 无高信号原创；关注列表仍无 DeepSeek 一手 X；DeepMind 工程博客今日未见新帖。
openingSummary.en: Over about a day the new leads are the Claude Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2 launch and a pairing of cheap everyday-agent models with research-side kill switches: @claudeai and @AnthropicAI introduced Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 (same underlying model; Fable ships stronger safeguards to all paid users and major clouds, while Mythos is gated behind Life Sciences / Cyber verification). Official benches put FrontierCode 2.0 at about 49.1% at Xhigh effort, ahead of Opus 5.5 (45.5%), GPT-6 Astra (42.8%), and Gemini 4 Carbon (41.1% Medium); API pricing drops to $8/$40 per million input/output tokens (optional fast mode $16/$80), and Anthropic still recommends Opus 5.5 as the daily driver for most coding and knowledge work. @OpenAI described Control Room, which ties research inference—including agentic sampling—into a central halt path that stops model output within about 35 seconds of an intervene decision. @AIatMeta launched Muse Ember, a small model for everyday agent steps (1M context, $0.10/$0.50) that it says matches Claude Haiku 5.5 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at roughly one-third the cost per task and beats GPT-6 Luna across Luna’s reasoning settings. On the research side, alphaXiv’s hot list highlights agent papers SwarmEvolve, Video-Coder, and FlashState. Gaps: @karpathy / @AndrewYNg / @GoogleAI / @GoogleDeepMind / @Meta quiet on high-signal originals in ~48h; still no DeepSeek primary X on the watchlist; no new DeepMind eng post today.

summary.en: Meta introduces Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient model for everyday agent work—cross-app workflows, sequenced tool calls, tests, and targeted code fixes—with a 1M-token context and native text/image/audio/video understanding. title.zh: Claude Fable 5.2 与 Mythos 5.2：面向最难技术工作的升级
title.en: Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2

summary.zh: 11/9（北京时间约 11/10 凌晨）发布。Fable 与 Mythos 为同一底座；Fable 面向所有付费计划、Claude Platform 及 AWS / Google Cloud / Azure，API $8/$40，可选 fast mode（最高约 2.5× 出字）$16/$80。官方表：FrontierCode 2.0 Xhigh 49.1%（Fable 5.1 32.4%，Opus 5.5 45.5%，GPT-6 Astra 42.8%，Gemini 4 Carbon 41.1% Medium）；FrontierSWE v2 69.9%；HLE（带工具）74.2%；RoboDojo Sim 64.9%。并称 1000 个 Fable agent 用 30 小时形式化费马大定理（同设置下 Opus 5.5 在 18 小时仅完成约 26%）。日常编码仍建议先用 Opus 5.5。
summary.en: Published Nov 9 (about early Nov 10 Asia/Shanghai). Fable and Mythos share one underlying model; Fable is on all paid plans, the Claude Platform, and AWS / Google Cloud / Azure at $8/$40, with optional fast mode (up to ~2.5× generation) at $16/$80. Official table: FrontierCode 2.0 Xhigh 49.1% (Fable 5.1 32.4%, Opus 5.5 45.5%, GPT-6 Astra 42.8%, Gemini 4 Carbon 41.1% Medium); FrontierSWE v2 69.9%; HLE with tools 74.2%; RoboDojo Sim 64.9%. Anthropic also says 1,000 Fable agents formalized Fermat’s Last Theorem in 30 hours (Opus 5.5 completed about 26% in 18 hours in the same setup). Opus 5.5 remains the recommended daily driver for most coding.

title.zh: Control Room：跟踪并紧急停止研究侧模型负载
title.en: Control Room: track and stop model workloads across research infrastructure

summary.zh: 约 11/9–11/10：OpenAI 介绍已部署在研究基础设施上的中央控制系统，覆盖含 agentic sampling 的训练/评测与数据处理等推理负载；与错位监测联动，决定干预后约 35 秒内停止模型输出，并设计成自身故障时也能切断输出。属安全工程基础设施，而非新基座模型发版。
summary.en: Around Nov 9–10: OpenAI describes a central control system already deployed on its research stack. It covers research inference—including agentic sampling for training and evaluation plus data processing—works with misalignment monitors, aims to halt output within about 35 seconds of an intervene decision, and is designed to fail closed if Control Room itself goes down. Safety infrastructure, not a new frontier-model launch.

title.zh: Muse Ember：最小、最省、面向日常 Agent 步骤
title.en: Introducing Our Smallest, Most Efficient Model: Muse Ember

summary.zh: 约 11/9：Muse Ember（API `muse-ember-1.0`）定价 $0.10 / $0.50（缓存输入 $0.004），1M 上下文、最长约 512K 输出。官方引用 AA：Intelligence Index 接近 Haiku 5.5、单任务成本约 $0.14（对比 Spark 1.3 约 $2.39）；AutomationBench-AA max 37.8%（Luna 20.2%，Haiku 5.5 13.9%）；Coding Agent Index-AA 46（Haiku 37，Luna 31）。FrontierCode 2.0-AA 上 Ember 27.2%，低于 Haiku 5.5 的 34.9%。亦登陆 Google Cloud，并与 Muse Wonder / Spark 1.3 一起组成产品组合。
summary.en: Around Nov 9: Muse Ember (`muse-ember-1.0`) is $0.10 / $0.50 ($0.004 cached input) with a 1M context and up to ~512K output. Meta cites AA figures: Intelligence Index near Haiku 5.5 and about $0.14 per AA task (vs ~$2.39 for Spark 1.3); AutomationBench-AA max 37.8% (Luna 20.2%, Haiku 5.5 13.9%); Coding Agent Index-AA 46 (Haiku 37, Luna 31). On FrontierCode 2.0-AA, Ember is 27.2% vs Haiku 5.5’s 34.9%. It also landed on Google Cloud alongside Muse Wonder and Spark 1.3.

alphaxivTop3.title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization

summary.zh: （Agent 优先；alphaXiv 热榜约第 8）数百小 LLM Agent 在潜空间推理、经 KV cache 通信，无需长文本 CoT；作者称单卡可在数分钟内做数学/科学程序演化搜索，强调速度与多样性。
summary.en: (Agent pick; ~#8 on alphaXiv’s trending list) Hundreds of small LLM agents reason in latent space and communicate via KV-cache transfer (no long text CoT); authors report evolutionary math/science program search in minutes on one GPU, stressing speed and diversity.

alphaxivTop3.title: Video-Coder: Reinforcing Agentic Coding for Video Generation
alphaxivTop3.authors: Chaoyang Wang, Sicheng Gao, Junan Hu, Kunyang Li, Dongyang Chen et al.

summary.zh: （Agentic coding 优先；热榜约第 9）训练一个写代码的视频生成 Agent：自动编写并执行代码以搭建动态 3D 场景草稿，再引导视频生成；结合 SFT 与 harness/执行反馈，并开源数据、模型与代码。
summary.en: (Agentic-coding pick; ~#9 on the trending list) Trains a code-driven video-generation agent that writes and runs code to build a dynamic 3D scene draft, then steers a video generator; trained with SFT plus harness/execution feedback, with data, models, and code released.

alphaxivTop3.title: FlashState: Unlocking Flexible Hybrid State Management for Agentic LLM Serving
alphaxivTop3.authors: Chenxi Li, Weili Xu, Tianyi Zhang, Jue Wang, Zhongzhu Zhou, Chenfeng Xu

summary.zh: （Agent serving / coding-agent 优先；热榜约第 10）针对混合模型服务提出 Agentic Hybrid State Management，让请求能在精确的历史端点恢复，减少重复 prefill；文中以 coding-agent 负载（GLM-5.3-Flash、Nemotron 3 Super、Qwen3.8-Flash-Next）说明吞吐收益。
summary.en: (Agent-serving / coding-agent pick; ~#10 on the trending list) Frames Agentic Hybrid State Management so hybrid-model servers can resume requests at exact prior endpoints and cut repeated prefill; reports gains on coding-agent workloads with GLM-5.3-Flash, Nemotron 3 Super, and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next.

summary.zh: 新品：Claude Fable 5.2 与 Claude Mythos 5.2（Anthropic 新闻页标注 2026-11-09；北京时间约 11/10 凌晨）。同一底座；Fable 带更强安全护栏，现已登陆所有付费计划、Claude Platform 及 AWS / Google Cloud / Azure，开发者模型名 `claude-fable-5-2`；Mythos 需生命科学/网络安全验证项目申请。定价 $8/$40（较此前 $10/$50 下降），可选 fast mode $16/$80（最高约 2.5× 出字）。官方评测（最高努力档，除非另注）：FrontierCode 2.0 Xhigh 49.1% vs Opus 5.5 45.5% / GPT-6 Astra 42.8% / Gemini 4 Carbon 41.1%（Medium）；FrontierSWE v2 69.9%；HLE（带工具）74.2%；OSWorld 2.1（offline partial）89.3%；RoboDojo Sim 64.9%；RLI High 41.3%。官方建议大多数编码与知识工作仍从 Opus 5.5 起步，再按任务复杂度上调到 Fable/Mythos 或下调到 Sonnet/Haiku 5.5。
summary.en: New: Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 (dated Nov 9, 2026 on Anthropic News; early Nov 10 Asia/Shanghai). Same underlying model; Fable’s stronger safeguards allow availability on all paid plans, the Claude Platform, and AWS / Google Cloud / Azure as `claude-fable-5-2`; Mythos access is via Life Sciences / Cyber verification. Pricing is $8/$40 (down from $10/$50), with optional fast mode at $16/$80 (up to ~2.5× generation). Official benches (highest available effort unless noted): FrontierCode 2.0 Xhigh 49.1% vs Opus 5.5 45.5% / GPT-6 Astra 42.8% / Gemini 4 Carbon 41.1% (Medium); FrontierSWE v2 69.9%; HLE with tools 74.2%; OSWorld 2.1 offline partial 89.3%; RoboDojo Sim 64.9%; RLI High 41.3%. Anthropic still recommends starting with Opus 5.5 for most coding and knowledge work, then moving up to Fable/Mythos or down to Sonnet/Haiku 5.5.
